primary.title: Your gold or silver ETF holds physical bullion: Here's what SEBI's new vault rules mean for investors
primary.summary: SEBI has approved changes to its vault manager rules, bringing physical bullion underlying gold and silver ETFs under a common framework. The move strengthens requirements around how this bullion is stored, secured, segregated and accounted for.
